cap: Two-storey house with grey siding, white trim and a stone-clad front porch, with a landscaped front garden
Front home office with tall windows, grey walls and wide-plank laminate floors
White shaker kitchen with a quartz island, stainless steel appliances and a gas range
Kitchen island with bar seating, open to the living area and the main staircase
Living room with a gas fireplace under a wall-mounted TV, open to the kitchen and stairs
Primary bedroom with a vaulted ceiling and French doors to a balcony
Laundry room with a front-load washer and dryer and white upper cabinets
Carpeted family room with a grey sectional sofa
Covered upper deck with glass railings looking over the neighbourhood rooftops
